Huichun Yang is a Providence-based Taiwanese sound artist, improviser, and computer music programmer. Inspired by the physicality of balloons, her performance explores breath as sonic material, speaking with her history and surroundings. She works with pressure and tension that disturb the boundaries of bodies, making balloon noise with latex, breath, and mouth shape to create different resonances—an untranslatable voice, detached from context but visceral and tactile in vibration. She is interested in spatial audio environment that disturb the hierarchy of the listening from linear to parallel.
Huichun has performed at the Residual Noise (2025, Providence), SOUND/IMAGE Festival (2024, London), among other events. She has led Live Coding workshops at Digital Media and .

U.S. Navy admiral and engineer (1900–1986), known as the "Father of the Nuclear Navy". He built the naval nuclear propulsion program and drove development of the first nuclear-powered submarine, USS Nautilus.

His real achievement was institutional, not just technical: he turned reactor safety into an engineering culture rather than a regulatory afterthought — fusing conservative design, written procedure, deep operator training, personal accountability, and cradle-to-grave lifecycle ownership into the organization that built and ran the reactors. Someone always had the authority to stop work until standards were met.

The reason to note him here is the analogy to : powerful technology may need more than external regulation or safety slogans. Safety becomes durable when technical competence, procedural rigor, accountability, and lifecycle ownership are built into the institution itself.

Coins the term "dopamine fracking": pumping immense, disproportionate resources into a previously casual or complex activity to forcefully extract the purest dopamine hit, with no regard for anything else.
Draws on Person/Metta Beshay's research on drugs in cultural context — when activities are industrialized purely for dopamine extraction, their complexity and meaning vanish.

The strawberry analogy: isolating a single aromatic compound removes texture, juiciness, complexity — "about 500 individual human experiences" — replacing diverse, imperfect experiences with identical synthetic ones.
Capitalism ensures "Everything converges on a single point, there's quite literally no room for anything else."
Connects to Person/David Wilson/Blog/26/05/The solution might be cancelling my AI subscription on AI as a friction-removal tool that erases commitment and focus.
Proposed remedy: awareness and personal limits — deliberately avoiding content that exploits dopaminergic triggers.
